## School Demographic and Characteristic Breakdowns

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| 1.  Data frame one: school “characteristics”- this would be for identifying which schools are similar |
|     1.  Student population breakdowns- demographics, ESL, economic disadvantage, etc.                 |
|     2.  Size of school                                                                                |
|     3.  Type of school: charter, public, by-right, in-boundary                                        |
|     4.  Grade levels                                                                                  |
| 2.  Data frame two: school metrics                                                                    |
|     1.  Enrollment                                                                                    |
|     2.  Test scores                                                                                   |
|     3.  Grad rates                                                                                    |
|     4.  College                                                                                       |
|     5.  Etc etc more vars I’m not naming here                                                         |
|                                                                                                       |
| Then join to one big data frame, each school is a row.                                                |
